name: Hydroelectric Power
formula: P = η · ρ · Q · g · h
description: Calculates the electrical power generated by a hydroelectric plant (used for questions 10 and 11). P is power, η is turbine generator efficiency, ρ is water density, Q is volumetric flow rate, g is acceleration due to gravity, and h is the head height.

name: Wind Turbine Power
description: Calculates the total power produced by a wind turbine (used for question 12). P is power, ρ is air density, A is the swept area of the blades (calculated as πr² where r is the blade length), and v is the wind velocity.
